[EN] It's painful to watch Khasib panting after Nashwa. We have a saying: no use wishing yourself up a cliff you can't climb. He's way out of his league.
[ES] Es doloroso ver a Khasib suspirando por Nashwa. Tenemos un dicho: no sirve de nada desear trepar por un acantilado que no puedes escalar. Está muy fuera de su alcance.
